status: FROZEN. Records may be generated only from this file and only with the code at base_commit; definitions must not be changed to fix a result.

decisions.size: about 40 diagnostic states; actual: 21 pairs = 42 states = 42 records
decisions.split: none: no formal train/test split for this diagnostic pilot
decisions.horizon_sensitive_family: s03 included only if every member's per-horizon evidence holds (horizon_audit); each horizon reported separately
decisions.pooling: kept separate from all historical datasets
decisions.loading: version-aware loader and validator for prompt builders 1.0.0 and 1.1.0

simulator_assumptions: custom re-activation: re-creating a revoked custom link (same file and address) re-activates the same record
generated identifier and token are non-core: functional restoration ignores them
token reservation: a generated token can never be claimed as a custom address

families.pivot_factor: address kind of the revoked link
revoked custom record for the requested address
revoked custom record for the requested address

generation.counting_rule: one base scenario = one minimal pair = two states (one per pivot value) = two records (one render style per scenario, shared by both members)
generation.planner_rule: deterministic per (seed, family, scenario, attempt); a draw is redrawn if either member repeats the coarse canonical structure of any earlier planned state in the pilot
generation.render_styles: kv, prose, compact cycled by scenario index; no style is test-only because there is no split
generation.class_balance: not forced; no I examples by design (the policy-blocked irreversible case is excluded, docs/29)

gold_entry_gates: well-formed state: validate_state, exact round trip, link ids contiguous from lnk-0001
judged action succeeds (an id-allocation refusal is named link_id_allocation_failed)

per-horizon evidence at h = 1, 2, 3 (R: exact witness <= h replays to canonical equality; P: approximate witness <= h replays to core but not canonical equality, and an exhaustive search through h finds no exact witness; I: exhaustive, no witness), agreeing with the primary assessment
label_rules.pair_rule: if either member fails a gate the whole pair is dropped and counted
label_rules.expectations_and_declared_reversibility: compared and reported only; never change a gold label or drop a record
label_rules.partial: label_provisional with partial_reversibility_definition_pending_professor, as in earlier pilots
label_rules.oq21_alternative: not applicable to link tools; Candidate A diagnostics showed 0 label changes
label_rules.validator: adnn.dataset.validation with split=None and LINK_PILOT_THRESHOLDS; re-checks ids, replays every stored witness

planned_in_memory_not_records.note: computed by this script without writing records; generation still requires a frozen manifest

gates_descriptive.SD1_note: every link record is canonically new against the named priors by construction (new state field and new tools); not evidence of diversity

sensitivity_prior_not_a_gate.name: candidate_a_diagnostics_D1_D9
sensitivity_prior_not_a_gate.reason: same mechanism; novelty against it is the informative within-mechanism figure

SD1.metric: fraction of gold records whose coarse canonical scenario is absent from every named prior dataset
SD1.caveat: mechanically inflated: no prior record has share_links or a link tool; met by construction and not evidence of diversity

SD2.metric: maximum gold records per coarse canonical scenario

SD3.metric: coarse canonical groups, pooled with the named priors, whose members' labels_by_horizon or recovery signature differ

stop_conditions.SD4: deferred until an explicit, auditable mechanism taxonomy and irreversibility-cause representation exist; recovery signatures are not causal mechanisms
stop_conditions.on_failure: report and stop; no reseeding or planner tuning after seeing results

scenario_level: every planned state has a distinct strict and coarse canonical scenario
overlap with prior-dataset and diagnostic scenarios reported (strict and coarse)
family_level: no split, so there is no train/test family leakage to check; families are reported separately and never pooled with historical datasets
leakage_checks.prompt: validator leakage tokens plus tests: no label word, depth, witness, scenario/family/pair id or recovery certificate in 1.1.0 prompts

reporting: strict and coarse canonical counts separately: within the pilot, per family, against each named prior, against the diagnostics; recovery signatures and concentration (max share, inverse-Simpson effective number) per family, label, render style and background factor; each horizon separately

novelty_inflation_risk.risk: share_links is a new state field and the link tools are new actions, so SD1 against the named priors is mechanically about 1.0
mitigations: SD2 and within-pilot distinct coarse counts are the binding diversity measures
novelty against the Candidate A diagnostics is the within-mechanism figure
recovery-signature counts and concentration are reported next to structural counts, so background variation is not read as mechanism variation

exclusions: generated-address create (always P, no state-dependent pair)
states with link-id gaps or other malformed hand-built states (gate)

freeze_confirmation.horizon_reporting: labels and evidence reported separately at h = 1, 2, 3; s03 labels are horizon-relative (P at h1/h2, R at h3 only because h3 equals the exact depth)
freeze_confirmation.split_note: no formal train/test split for this diagnostic pilot
freeze_confirmation.pooling: kept separate from all historical datasets
freeze_confirmation.sd1_warning: SD1 is mechanically inflated for this new tool family: no record in the named priors has a share_links field or a link tool, so every link record is novel by construction. SD1 is reported but is not evidence of diversity or of causal novelty.
freeze_confirmation.coverage_not_mechanisms: the 42 records are diagnostic coverage of one mechanism (Candidate A sharing links) with 5 recovery signatures; they are not 42 independent causal mechanisms

generation_procedure.runner: scripts/dataset/phase5e_generate_pilot.py (orchestration only; refuses to run unless this manifest matches its sha256 sidecar, HEAD descends from base_commit and src/adnn is unchanged since base_commit)
generation_procedure.outputs: results/phase5e/pilot/run1 and run2 (git-ignored): records.jsonl, tool_sets.json, manifest.json, generation_report.json
generation_procedure.determinism: run twice; records.jsonl and tool_sets.json must be byte-identical
generation_procedure.validation: adnn.dataset.validation.validate_directory with LINK_PILOT_THRESHOLDS and adnn.dataset.api.load_dataset with every probe and stated prompt hash-checked
stop_and_report_if: any pair fails its contract or any gate (no selective regeneration)
any label lacks per-horizon evidence or any witness does not replay
the validator or the loader reports an error
a prospective diversity gate fails (reported, not forced)

decisions_resolved: 42 states with 5 recovery signatures and no I class accepted as diagnostic coverage (Phase 5E Task 3)
